entries.en: We have some kind of maintenance shaft.
entries.ro: Avem un fel de puț de întreținere.

entries.en: If you stop to think, it's incredible we happen to be standing right where the AHQ bomb left a huge crater.
entries.ro: Dacă te gândești bine, e incredibil că tocmai aici suntem, unde bomba AHQ a lăsat craterul ăla uriaș.

entries.en: It looks like it leads upwards.
Then... isn't this place positively saturated with radiation?
entries.ro: Atunci... locul ăsta nu e plin de radiații?

entries.en: Means we're still below the basement.
entries.ro: Înseamnă că suntem încă sub subsol.

entries.en: They're designed to protect buildings against earthquakes.
entries.ro: Sunt făcute ca să protejeze clădirile de cutremure.

entries.en: Right. We have to find a way to a level higher up.
entries.ro: Bine. Trebuie să găsim drum spre un nivel mai sus.

entries.en: We have to down the drones!
